body.name: Total split-sample empirical-packing estimator
body.construction: Split the sample into \(I_1\) and \(I_2\). Let \(H_n=\{h_02^{-j}:0\leq j\leq\lceil\log_2n\rceil\}\) and \(U_n=\{0,1\}\cup\{2^{-\ell}:0\leq\ell\leq\lceil\log_2(n_1\vee1)\rceil\}\). On \(I_1\), set \(\widehat q^{(1)}_t(x,h)=(n_1\vee1)^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_1}\mathbf1\{X_i\in A_t,\|X_i-x\|_2\leq h\}\). With \(b_n(v)=\sqrt{12v\log(en)/(n_1\vee1)}+20\log(en)/(n_1\vee1)\), set \(q^U_t=\min\{1,\widehat q^{(1)}_t+b_n(\widehat q^{(1)}_t)\}\), \(q^L_t=\max\{0,\widehat q^{(1)}_t-b_n(\widehat q^{(1)}_t)\}\), \(a^U=\min_tq^U_t\), and \(a^L=\min_tq^L_t\). For each \(h\in H_n\), form the finite source-labeled list consisting of \((-1/2,0,0)\), \((1/2,0,1)\), and every \((S_i+e\sqrt{h^2-R_i^2},i,e)\) with \(i\in I_1\), \(e\in\{-1,1\}\), \(|R_i|\leq h\), and \(S_i+e\sqrt{h^2-R_i^2}\in[-1/2,1/2]\). Sort lexicographically by boundary coordinate, then by \(i\), then by \(e\), and discard repeated coordinates after retaining the least source label. Write the remaining coordinates as \(-1/2=z_0<\cdots<z_M=1/2\), define \(C_1(h)=((0,z_0),\ldots,(0,z_M))\), and set \(G_1(h)=\{(0,z_j):0\leq j\leq M\}\cup\{(0,(z_j+z_{j+1})/2):0\leq j<M\}\). For \(v\in[0,1]\), round \(v\) upward to the smallest \(u(v)\in U_n\) and set \(\widehat J(h,v)=1\vee\max\{|F|:F\subseteq G_1(h),\|x-x'\|_2\geq h/2,a^U(x,h/4)\leq u(v)\}\). Let \(\widehat u(x,h)\) be the smallest severity layer at least \(\min\{1,4a^U(x,h)\}\). On \(I_2\), set \(N^{(2)}_t(x,h)=\sum_{i\in I_2}\mathbf1\{X_i\in A_t,\|X_i-x\|_2\leq h\}\) and define the raw average everywhere by \(\widetilde Y^{(2)}_t(x,h)=0\) when \(N^{(2)}_t(x,h)=0\), and \(\widetilde Y^{(2)}_t(x,h)=N^{(2)}_t(x,h)^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_2}Y_i\mathbf1\{X_i\in A_t,\|X_i-x\|_2\leq h\}\) otherwise. Set \(\overline Y^{(2)}_t(x,h)=\Pi_L(\widetilde Y^{(2)}_t(x,h))\). Among \(h\in H_n\) with \(n_2a^L(x,h)\geq64\{1+\log(e\widehat J(h,\widehat u(x,h)))\}\), choose the smallest minimizer of \(Lh+4\sigma\sqrt{\{1+\log(e\widehat J(h,\widehat u(x,h)))\}/\{n_2a^L(x,h)\}}\); set \(\widehat h(x)=h_0\) when this set is empty. Finally set \(\widehat\tau_n(x)=\Pi_{2L}(\overline Y^{(2)}_1(x,\widehat h(x))-\overline Y^{(2)}_0(x,\widehat h(x)))\).
